name: negative_source_values
description: Negative source values: a -5 V source and a current source whose -2 mA means current actually flows the other way.
derivation: V1 = -5 V across the divider R1 = R2 = 1k, so v_a = -5 V and v_m = -2.5 V without I1. Superposing I1 (-2 mA into m, that is, 2 mA drawn out of m) through R1 || R2 = 500 Ω (the source V1 is a short for superposition) adds -1 V: v_m = -3.5 V. I(R1) = (-5 - (-3.5))/1k = -1.5 mA, I(R2) = -3.5/1k = -3.5 mA. V1 current = -I(R1) = +1.5 mA.
